headline: Signs of Employer Interference Found at GLM Components After USMCA Investigation Concludes
summary: A USMCA Rapid Response Labor Mechanism investigation found GLM Components allowed a union delegate without the collective contract to conduct union activities during working hours. The probe concluded with these findings.
why: USMCA labor enforcement can lead to remediation requirements that affect manufacturers operating in Mexico's export supply chains.
original_headline: Detectan indicios de injerencia patronal en GLM Components tras concluir investigación del T-MEC
